metadata.title: Nagpur City Police public station directory snapshot
metadata.fields_note: Publicly listed station names, phones, emails and address text only. No non-public FIRs, victim information, complaint narratives or live operational records are included.
metadata.coordinate_policy: latitude and longitude are null until each facility coordinate is independently matched and human-reviewed against an open mapping source. Do not generate coordinates from name guesses.
metadata.jurisdiction_policy: This export mirrors listings found on the official Nagpur City Police page. It is not a guarantee of current station boundaries or dispatch jurisdiction.
